integrity: The proof is universal and module-theoretic. Its nontrivial inputs are the idempotent-chain criterion for perspectivity, lifting of rlr chains through the Jacobson radical, and orthogonal idempotent lifting in semiregular rings; the recent primary source states or uses each of these ingredients.
scientific_limitations: The descent implication is asserted only for semiregular rings, where compatible idempotent lifting is available.
No statement is made for arbitrary quotient ideals or for the ordinary Schröder–Bernstein property.
The foundational Keef–Koşan full text was not openly available during the comparison; its publisher preview and abstract were inspected and this access limitation is retained as an originality risk.
title: Radical invariance of the perspective–Schröder–Bernstein property for semiregular rings
